about_the_game:
The LOVE LIFE DLC adds the following to Dungeon Dreams 2:

  • One unique post-marriage quest for each one of all available spouses

  • New special date before the final battle and more dialogue lines during casual dates, as well as some new dates

  • New casual dialogue options for hugging and cute stuff, also waking up your spouse while in bed

  • Some spouses will prepare a meal to-go for you on the table in the mornings (but should you trust Lissbeth's cooking?)

  • A new building in Town: The Painter's Workshop, where you can purchase a portrait of your spouse too

  • New event: Combat Tournament for Couples! (adds 2 new NPCs too)

  • Cooking Class for Couples

  • Escape Room for Couples ("Chamber of Bonds"), also adds a new kitsune to the Hot Springs

  • Academy General Culture Quiz for couples!

    But wait, there's more!

    Brelide, Lady of Haruka, comes to town asking YOU for help!

    Embark on a long journey to the Port of Lockran, with new companions:

    And your spouse, tagging along.

    Here's Emilia asking for some privacy during camp.

    Maxine bonding with fellow travelling companions.

    Or Quinn, being...Quinn.

    Stay at camps, and stop at Inns, face the dangers of travelling out of Kalmaruss, and...hey, what's that?

    Two explorable towns!

Have fun exploring the world, romance and lore of Dungeon Dreams 2 further with Love Life DLC.
